top_datasets.problem_statement: This dataset enables the study of dynamic airflow disturbances in controlled environments, providing insights into real-time changes and anomalies.
top_datasets.user_story: As a researcher in aerospace, I want to use smoke image velocimetry data to understand airflow dynamics, so I can improve the design of ventilation systems.
top_datasets.cot_example: Given the change in smoke flow pattern at T1, explain the possible reasons and predict the subsequent airflow behavior.
top_datasets.timenet_task: Airflow pattern recognition and anomaly detection in controlled environments.
